note: T8 at 14 life, Bolt on stack plus 10 power of attackers: passed and fell to 1, which turned off both Ancient Tombs and Force of Will. Force of Will on the Bolt (pitching Show and Tell, which had no payoff) keeps A at 4; turn 9 then had Tomb + Petal for the second Show and Tell (found by Brainstorm), uncounterable under Veil, into Aluren and the Acererak loop.

T9 at 1 life, dead next turn, Veil resolved (spells uncounterable), land drop unused: passed holding Lotus Petal + Brainstorm. Petal into Brainstorm digs 3 for City of Traitors (Petal + City = Show and Tell for Aluren) or a land plus Petal; passing is a certain loss.

T1 Ponder showed Show and Tell, Veil of Summer, Ancient Tomb; hand had Acererak as its only creature (no black mana, so it needs Aluren) and no payoff for Show and Tell. Kept the order instead of shuffling; the three known draws were a redundant Veil, a land and a half-combo, and A then drew no payoff for 8 turns.

T6 Murktide 7/7 flier cast with B tapped out: A held Force of Will (only pitch: Show and Tell) and took the clock. Countering buys turns to find Aluren plus a second green source; keeping Show and Tell keeps the Atraxa route (Atraxa blocks Murktide). In fact B held 2 FoW, so it would have failed.

T9, A at 1 life cast Veil of Summer in response to B's Daze on Brainstorm; B held 2 Force of Will and passed. Resolved Veil makes all of A's spells uncounterable that turn and draws a card, so the Forces were blank exactly when A could combo; Force the Veil (pitch the other Force) and Daze stops the Brainstorm.
